column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
I was brought to Rinkai Park.  There were many people off of work.
Hey, what are we doing here?
This is the shooting location for my next job.
Oh?
If I don't personally experience it, I wouldn't get any of the feelings at that time, right?
To just pose on the spot... that would show my inexperience. I wanted to properly do at least a little preparatory work.
I see...
Hmm...
Kirino went around and examined the surroundings as if imagining how it would go on that day.
As she moved from place to place, she would continuously try different poses.
Like this, perhaps?
Hmmm... It seems like I can't quite get it after all.
Hey, take some pictures with your cell phone.
Huh?  Me?
Who else would there be?
That's right...
Here's the cell phone. Don't go poking around.
Right, okay, I got it.
Okay, start with this pose.
I'm taking it.
While I'm changing my pose, keep taking the pictures continuously.
Okaaay...
As I continued to take pictures like Kirino said, I looked at the screen.
The faces in the pictures I took were not of the detestable little sister, but the face of Kirino the model.
The expression was like something I once saw in a magazine.
A bright face, a playful and smiling face. It was Kirino bringing forth every ounce of her charms.
The dresses that she would wear would be happy, I was honestly thinking.
Kirino... That's incredible. I should've given you more credit.
Of course! I'm not doing this for fun. I'm a pro.
Of course.
Hey! C'mon, keep taking the pictures.
Right, right, I got it.
After some time of making me take pictures till she was satisfied, Kirino took her phone back and started to inspect the pictures.
Oh?! You're pretty good at taking them.
Wasn't it because the subject was good?
What's this all of a sudden?
That's what I really thought.
Huh? O-Of course I am!
Of course...
Well, with this quality, you deserve a reward.
Huh?  What do you mean, "reward?"
Heh heh...
Hey, who are you suddenly messaging?
Huh? A message from you?!
Hurry up and open it.
What's going on... Whoa?!?!
The message Kirino suddenly sent me had a picture attached.
It was a picture of her, one of the pictures she made me take.
She had an exceptionally glowing smile, the best shot of the series.
And with a very fitting pose, it wouldn't look out of place on the front cover of a magazine.
Hmm? I looked at the gap between Kirino's thighs where the skirt had exposed a little... This is pretty sexy, isn't it?
H-Hey!  What are you staring at it for?!
Hey, you don't have the right to say that after you sent it yourself.
F-Fine! ...Just don't use it for your wallpaper.
Who would use a picture of their own sister for a wallpaper?!
But, you're a siscon though...
Just what makes you think I'm a siscon?
Anyways, don't go showing it off to other people.
Like I could!
Okay, okay.
You absolutely can't, alright?
Yes, okay, I got it.  Well then, I've got some other--
Alright! Off to the next place!
Huh?
It looks like it's still not time for me to go home. *sigh*
